verdict.limitations: The assessment of pulmonary congestion is limited to the provided two-dimensional radiographs. Early or subtle signs of pulmonary congestion might not be discernible on plain film radiography. Clinical correlation and potentially further imaging or clinical evaluation would be necessary for a definitive assessment. The heart size assessment is also limited by patient positioning, phase of respiration, and body habitus. A definitive assessment of cardiac dimensions often requires echocardiography or other advanced imaging modalities.
